correctness.rationale: On n>=5 and 1<=s<=n-4 with s congruent n mod2, conditional uniform distribution on complementary complete shells X=±s has odd Walsh moments zero and distinct-coordinate pair moment rho=(s²-n)/(n(n-1)). The fourth moment and Johnson zero-row-sum relations yield odd radial s²/n, odd standard (n²-s²)/(n(n-1)), even radial 1+(s²-n)²/(2n(n-1)) and one zero kernel, even standard s²(n²-s²)/(n(n-1)(n-2)), even quadratic (n²-s²)((n-2)²-s²)/(n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)) with stated multiplicities. These fill the coefficient space and are positive at the boundaries. At n=m², s=m gives max n/(n-2), min 1-2/((n-2)(n-3)), squared condition ratio n(n-3)/((n-1)(n-4)). Every other legal s differs by at least 2; s<m gives ratio >=n/s², s>m gives ratio >s²/n, both exceed optimum. Sign symmetry and rho=0 give three-wise independence. Independently calculated exact rational eigenvalue branches and checked s=m±2 for m=3..200; not a proof substitute.
